items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: And maybe that’s where I’d be today if Ed Berger hadn’t called me and said, “Vinny, there’s a job at the Institute.

ctx.x: I taught this poor young lady to play piano behind me on this thing and I was terrible. I mean I am not a singer. I am horrible. And she put up with that. And today, we still talk about it today, sitting in the practice room, and she had to coach me into doing this. And another thing I did with the jazz thing is in the orchestration class we were given a little piece of music to orchestrate, and while they’re all doing classical things, I orchestrated a Duke Ellington thing. So every chance I got I tried to work…
Yeah. You were learning on the job.
